summary: A heading at h2, so the body base is 2 (section#body-heading-base). The body stores h2, h3, h4 and h6 (ID-3950): the highest-ranked, h2, draws at base + 1 (h3), h3 and h4 keep their distance (h4, h5), and h6, which would draw below h6 and skips a rank, draws h6.
